plan.title: fix(scope,swarm): decompose --check rejects size=large with parallel_safe=true (readiness parity)

narratives.Description: scope:decompose --check currently accepts size=large with parallel_safe=true while swarm:readiness rejects that combination. A draft can validate and receive digest approval, then fail allocation. This story enforces the same invariant in decompose --check before approval or apply.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm operator, I want decompose --check to reject large+parallel_safe drafts with the same rule as swarm:readiness, so that approved decompositions are always allocatable.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit packages/core/src/scope/decompose.ts validation used by --check (and apply re-validation) to reject plan.metadata.swarm size=large with parallel_safe=true using the same rule as packages/core/src/swarm/readiness.ts. Add fixtures in packages/core/src/scope/decompose.test.ts and packages/core/src/swarm/readiness-branches.test.ts. Run pnpm exec vitest on those packages and task check. Cite #3252 in CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased].
narratives.Overview: fix(scope,swarm): decompose --check rejects size=large with parallel_safe=true (readiness parity)
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a decompose draft story with swarm.size=large and parallel_safe=true, when scope:decompose --check runs, the command exits non-zero and names the large/parallel_safe invariant.
Given the same draft fields, when swarm:readiness evaluates the story, the failure class matches the decompose check message family.
Given CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3252 under Fixed.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/swarm
